utterance: An AWS EventBridge event rule named "cron" that is scheduled to make its target happen everyday at 7 UTC. The target should be linked to the existing Lambda function of our cron workload, the one deployed from the lambda_func.zip package as `cron-lambda-function`, and EventBridge has to be allowed to invoke it.

main.responsibility: owns the application's schedules and event wiring
main.intent: an ENABLED EventBridge schedule rule of the cron workload's own fires every day at 07:00 UTC with the cron workload's Lambda function as its target, and that function's resource policy lets events.amazonaws.com invoke it from that rule
